title: Tight cuts in matching covered graphs
summary: An edge cut C of a graph G is tight if |C \M| = 1 for every perfect matching M of G. Barrier-cuts and 2-separation cuts, also referred to as ELP-cuts, are two important types of tight cuts in matching covered graphs. Edmonds, Lovasz and Pulleyblank [Brick decompositions and the matching rank of graphs, Combinatorica 2(3) (1982) 247-274] proved that if a matching covered graph has a non-trivial tight cut, then it also has a non-trivial ELP-cut.
